audit_anchor: #include "rules/audits/r846_batch.h"  // R846: R846 FF monster level tables audit
audit_comment: THE FF ENCOUNTER LISTINGS - the outdoor terrain tables of the print pp. 111-119 with their subtables and the two plane tables: the Arctic, Sub-Arctic, temperate uninhabited, temperate inhabited and patrolled, Faerie and tropical tables (341 rows), the Demi-Human, Dragon, Frog, Giant, Humanoid, Lycanthrope, Men, Snake, Sphinx, Spider and Undead subtables plus the tropical Sphinx Subtable (86 rows), the Astral (24) and Ethereal (27) listings and the class level table (11 rows). THE WALK: 21 tables, 489 rows, every cell pinned (die band per terrain column, roster ordinal, source; the plane rows add the numbers-encountered pair and the special cell). THE SOURCES: the four-voice scan collation from the archive.org item tsr02012fiendfolio (the djvu text, the word-geometry xml, the abbyy char xml and the pdf hidden Acrobat Capture layer - the Faerie Plain and Mountains columns ride the pdf voice alone, the djvu and abbyy OCR missed them) with the 995 landed registry defs the advisory voice and the DMG Appendix C parity the tie-breaker. THE SRC CENSUS: 327 MM1 rows, 113 FF rows, 26 routing rows and 23 unkeyed rows and NO MM2 row (the print lists MM1 and FF creatures only). THE REPAIRS (79, the R703 pattern): 49 digit repairs - the dominant 8-to-6 scan class (the arctic Owl giant Plain 66-72 reads 68-72, the sub-arctic Troll Mountains 79-66 reads 79-86, the temperate Griffon Forest 26 reads 28, the Will-o-wisp Rough 69-90 reads 89-90, the Spider Desert 86-69 reads 86-89, the undead Shadow Hills 64-66 reads 64-68 and the Penanggalan Rough 66-72 reads 68-72, the Penanggalan Hills 69-63 reads 59-63, the Son of Kyuss Mountains 57-56 reads 57-58 and the Huecuva Forest S3-54 reads 53-54, the patrolled Ogre Plain 76-60 reads 78-80 and the Orc Plain 61-84 reads 81-84, the Skunk Plain 69-90 reads 89-90, the tropical Herd Scrub 26-37 reads 28-37 and the eight tropical 8-to-6 cells, the faerie Wolf Mountains 67-00 reads 87-00, the ethereal 88-94 and 79-80 and 81-82 bands and the three lost plane numbers cells), 16 ink star-for-hyphen repairs (the temperate Lizard man Marsh 44*47, Horse Forest 34*35, Treant Forest 81*62, Shambling mound Marsh 66*69, Sphinx Desert 77*85, Sphinx Mountains 77*60, Will-o-wisp Mountains 89*92, Wind walker Mountains 93*94, Wolf Hills 94*98, Wolf Mountains 95*96 and Worg Mountains 97*00 cells, the Dragon Subtable star-hyphen pattern, the undead Wight Mountains 80*95 and the patrolled Ghast, Ghost and Apparition Rough cells), 14 dash recoveries (the temperate Dune stalker, Boar, Al-miraj, Ant, Porcupine and Whip weed noise cells, the patrolled Wolf Marsh and Volt Forest cells, the sub-arctic Devil dog Mountains and Giant frost Marsh cells, and the undead Marsh void completions - the Son of Kyuss 82-84, the Vampire 94-95 and the Lich and Mummy dashes, the Vampire Mountains 69-79 both voices missed). THE DEFECT PINS (4): the Dragon Subtable Forest column prints no band 23 (the DMG carries the same hole), the patrolled Mountains gap 42-49 (the Men merchant band 50-51, the DMG reads 42-51, the Men nomad cell a dash), the patrolled Marsh gap 38 (the Men pilgrim 35-37 then the Ogre 39-46) and the patrolled Marsh gap 85 (the Vampire 80-84 then the Will-o-wisp 86-00) - pinned as ink, those columns do NOT assert their full tiling. THE CONTESTED ZONE: the sub-arctic Remorhaz, Rhinoceros and Tiger Rough and Mountains cells - settled by the pdf capture-layer column-order voice against the earlier-session call: the Rough column walks 73-74, dash, 75-78, dash, 79-82 (the Rhinoceros Rough cell a dash, the Tiger Rough 75-78) and the Mountains column walks 70-74, dash, 75-78 (the Remorhaz Mountains 75-78), dash, dash, dash, 79-86. THE NOTED INK: the arctic polar-bear and white-snake footnotes ride the Bear, brown and Snake, giant constrictor rows, the sub-arctic ruins, flinds and night-only footnotes ride the Dragon white, Gnoll and Owl giant rows, the tropical Lamia and lizard king footnotes and the bandit slavers note ride their rows, the Men Character row prints 10% in all cases (the per-column bands tiling-recovered), the men-90%-mounted note (one voice reads 00%), the arctic 75%-airborne italic note, the FF print spellings Grabman, Mantari, Tabari and Giant strider ride the standing crabman, mantari, tabaxi and giant strider defs (the R837 Grabman precedent), the plane slash rows read 50% each, the class level table pairs the Human Subtable traveller parties (the DMG parity: the BARD+ row reads 7th or 8th level fighter ability and 6th or 9th level thief ability, d4 for determination), and the ink name variants (Fernicon, Mastadcn, Quaggoth, PAnanggalan and the rest) pin as scanned with the roster riding the cleaned print names. No defs promoted this round - the registry floor holds at 995; the round-roster ordinal (356 labels) walks every creature, routing label, subtable type, plane row and character class the tables carry.
